prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Project asset: Unit 5–6 friends meeting, an isolated miniature school courtyard ground for a learning journey game. Generate a NEW environment ground sprite, 1536 x 1024 landscape 3:2, actual alpha transparent background.
Reference roles: Image 1 opening map and Image 2 neighborhood map are the authoritative ENVIRONMENT STYLE references: warm coral plaster and cream sandstone, softly rounded architectural volumes, painterly casual-game illustration, delicate teal green shrubs, gentle warm light from upper left. Images 3 friends trio and 4 interview couple are only scale and palette references; DO NOT reproduce any people or their silhouettes.
Composition: a single complete low, wide, oval/organic cream stone courtyard platform, subtly thick coral stone sidewall, floating as a cutout on true transparency, with at least 8% transparent margin on all four edges. Quiet small coral school door facade at the back edge only, well below visual prominence of future characters; a tiny cream roof/terracotta canopy, turquoise closed door, no symbols and no clocks. Building restricted to upper back zone y=0.15..0.48, modest width. Teal foliage with a few pale daisies only at outside edges x<0.16 or x>0.84.
Essential geometry: broad FLAT empty cream paved main floor continuously spanning x=0.18..0.82 and y=0.56..0.81 of full image. Future feet rest on y=0.72 and no floor obstacles can occur there. No raised rim or steps crossing this central area. Future three characters will occupy x=.22..78, y=.08..72: the building is a very small distant backdrop, not the main subject. Platform must visibly support those feet and stay entirely in frame. Fine stone joints allowed, soft baked platform shadow with real alpha. Camera matches references: gentle elevated isometric-like three-quarter garden map view, not a top-down plan.
Constraints: absolutely NO people, humanoids, animals, faces, stars, medals, numbers, text, logos, UI, labels, lamps, furniture, desks, chairs or central props. No large background scenery, sky, water rectangle, white rectangle, black rectangle, checkerboard pattern, hard rectangular backdrop or cropped platform. Maintain reference warm cream/coral/teal harmonious environment rendering, not plastic photorealism. The broad empty floor is mandatory.
